prompt:
Users want to duplicate an episode, to try another take without losing the original.
- Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/duplicate`, returning the new episode. The copy goes after the project's other episodes, its title marks it as a copy, and it keeps the summary and the same cuts in the same order, with their scripts, dialogues, layouts, characters and images. Changing or deleting either episode afterwards never affects the other. Duplicating is free. Only members of the episode's workspace may duplicate it; to anyone else the episode does not exist (404).
- On the project's Episodes page, every episode gets a Duplicate action next to Delete, and the copy shows up in the list without a reload. Both languages.
Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Change of plan for the order: a copy goes right after its original, and the episodes after it move down one place. Deleting an episode closes the gap. A project's episodes are always numbered 1, 2, 3… with no gaps or repeats, and the list API returns them in that order.
Keep the tests up to date.

Users delete episodes by mistake. Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore`: a deleted episode comes back with its cuts at the place it had, and the episodes from there on move down one place. Only members of its workspace may restore it; to anyone else it does not exist (404).
On the Episodes page, the message shown after a delete offers Undo, which restores the episode. Both languages. Add tests.

+from uuid import UUID, uuid4

+def _create_project(client, headers, title="Shadow Alley"):
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=headers, json={"title": title, "genres": []})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def _create_episode(client, headers, project_id, title="Episode 1", order=1, summary="Opening scene"):
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "title": title,
+            "project_id": project_id,
+            "episode_order": order,
+            "story_summary": summary,
+        },
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def test_duplicate_episode_copies_metadata_cuts_and_places_last(client):
+    h = signup(client, "alice@example.com")
+    project = _create_project(client, h)
+    ep1 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Pilot", order=1, summary="Hero wakes up.")
+    _ep2 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Chapter 2", order=2, summary="Next chapter.")
+    _ep3 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Chapter 3", order=3, summary="Third chapter.")
+
+    # Populate background_info, character_outfits, and cuts with scripts, dialogues,
+    # layouts, characters, and images (including an Asset record).
+    r = client.put(
+        f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}",
+        headers=h,
+        json={
+            "background_info": "Rainy neon street",
+            "character_outfits": {"mina": "Yellow raincoat"},
+        },
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+
+    char_id = str(uuid4())
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        asset = Asset(
+            workspace_id=UUID(project["workspace_id"]),
+            filename="cut1.png",
+            file_url="cuts/ep1/cut1.png",
+            file_type="image/png",
+        )
+        session.add(asset)
+        session.flush()
+
+        cut1 = StoryCut(
+            episode_id=UUID(ep1["id"]),
+            cut_order=1,
+            script="Wide shot of the alley",
+            location="Alley",
+            time_of_day="Night",
+            transition_ref="Fade in",
+            selected_layout="wide",
+            aspect_ratio="16:9",
+            image_path="cuts/ep1/cut1.png",
+            image_asset_id=asset.id,
+            status="completed",
+            dialogues=[{"speaker": "Mina", "text": "Where am I?"}],
+            appearing_characters=[{"id": char_id, "name": "Mina"}],
+            refer_prev_cut=False,
+        )
+        cut2 = StoryCut(
+            episode_id=UUID(ep1["id"]),
+            cut_order=2,
+            script="Close up on Mina's eyes",
+            selected_layout="vertical",
+            aspect_ratio="9:16",
+            image_path="https://cdn.example.com/cut2.png",
+            status="completed",
+            dialogues=[{"speaker": "Mina", "text": "Let's move."}],
+            appearing_characters=[{"id": char_id, "name": "Mina"}],
+            refer_prev_cut=True,

+        session.add(cut1)
+        session.add(cut2)
+        session.commit()

+
+    assert dup["id"] != ep1["id"]

+    assert dup["episode_order"] == 2
+    assert dup["title"] != ep1["title"]
+    assert "copy" in dup["title"].lower()
+    assert dup["story_summary"] == "Hero wakes up."
+    assert dup["background_info"] == "Rainy neon street"
+    assert dup["character_outfits"] == {"mina": "Yellow raincoat"}
+    assert dup["first_cut_image"].endswith("cuts/ep1/cut1.png")
+
+    # Verify copy goes right after original and later episodes shift down one place

+

+        assert dc["script"] == oc["script"]
+        assert dc["selected_layout"] == oc["selected_layout"]
+        assert dc["aspect_ratio"] == oc["aspect_ratio"]
+        assert dc["dialogues"] == oc["dialogues"]
+        assert dc["appearing_characters"] == oc["appearing_characters"]
+        assert dc["image_path"] == oc["image_path"]

+    # Verify DB-only fields and independent Asset record

+        db_dup_cuts = session.exec(
+            select(StoryCut).where(StoryCut.episode_id == UUID(dup["id"])).order_by(StoryCut.cut_order)
+        ).all()
+        db_orig_cuts = session.exec(
+            select(StoryCut).where(StoryCut.episode_id == UUID(ep1["id"])).order_by(StoryCut.cut_order)
+        ).all()
+        assert db_dup_cuts[0].location == "Alley"
+        assert db_dup_cuts[0].time_of_day == "Night"
+        assert db_dup_cuts[0].transition_ref == "Fade in"
+        assert db_dup_cuts[0].image_asset_id is not None
+        assert db_dup_cuts[0].image_asset_id != db_orig_cuts[0].image_asset_id
+

+        from app.models import Workspace
+
+        ws = session.get(Workspace, UUID(ws_id))
+        ws.credits = 0
+        session.add(ws)
+        session.commit()
+
+    project = _create_project(client, h)
+    ep = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Zero Credit Ep", order=1)
+
+    res = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}/duplicate", headers=h)
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+
+    workspaces_after = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=h).json()
+    assert workspaces_after[0]["credits"] == 0
+

+def test_duplicate_episode_workspace_permissions_and_not_found(client):
+    owner_headers = signup(client, "owner@example.com")
+    outsider_headers = signup(client, "outsider@example.com")
+    teammate_headers = signup(client, "teammate@example.com")
+
+    project = _create_project(client, owner_headers)
+    ep = _create_episode(client, owner_headers, project["id"], title="Private Ep", order=1)
+
+    # Unauthenticated -> 401
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}/duplicate").status_code == 401
+
+    # Non-member -> 404 (episode does not exist to them)
+    r_outsider = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}/duplicate", headers=outsider_headers)
+    assert r_outsider.status_code == 404
+
+    # Unknown episode UUID -> 404
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{uuid4()}/duplicate", headers=owner_headers).status_code == 404
+
+    # Add teammate as member of the workspace -> allowed
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        teammate = session.exec(select(User).where(User.email == "teammate@example.com")).first()
+        session.add(WorkspaceMember(workspace_id=UUID(project["workspace_id"]), user_id=teammate.id, role="member"))
+        session.commit()
+
+    r_teammate = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}/duplicate", headers=teammate_headers)
+    assert r_teammate.status_code == 200, r_teammate.text
+
+    # Soft-deleted episode -> 404
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}", headers=owner_headers).status_code == 204
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}/duplicate", headers=owner_headers).status_code == 404
+

+def test_episode_numbering_has_no_gaps_or_repeats_across_duplicate_delete_and_create(client):
+    h = signup(client, "order@example.com")
+    project = _create_project(client, h)
+
+    ep1 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 1", order=1)
+    # Out-of-range order on create should still produce 1, 2, 3...
+    ep2 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 2", order=99)
+    ep3 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 3", order=3)
+
+    listed = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [(e["id"], e["episode_order"]) for e in listed] == [
+        (ep1["id"], 1),
+        (ep2["id"], 2),
+        (ep3["id"], 3),
+    ]
+
+    # Duplicate middle episode (ep2) -> goes to position 3, ep3 shifts to 4
+    ep2_copy = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}/duplicate", headers=h).json()
+    assert ep2_copy["episode_order"] == 3
+    listed = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [(e["id"], e["episode_order"]) for e in listed] == [
+        (ep1["id"], 1),
+        (ep2["id"], 2),
+        (ep2_copy["id"], 3),
+        (ep3["id"], 4),
+    ]
+
+    # Duplicate last episode (ep3) -> goes to position 5
+    ep3_copy = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep3['id']}/duplicate", headers=h).json()
+    assert ep3_copy["episode_order"] == 5
+
+    # Delete ep2 (order 2) -> closes gap so ep2_copy=2, ep3=3, ep3_copy=4
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    listed = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [(e["id"], e["episode_order"]) for e in listed] == [
+        (ep1["id"], 1),
+        (ep2_copy["id"], 2),
+        (ep3["id"], 3),
+        (ep3_copy["id"], 4),
+    ]
+
+    # Delete first episode (ep1) -> remaining shift to 1, 2, 3
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    listed = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [(e["id"], e["episode_order"]) for e in listed] == [
+        (ep2_copy["id"], 1),
+        (ep3["id"], 2),
+        (ep3_copy["id"], 3),
+    ]
+
+    # Creating at an existing order (1) shifts existing episodes without repeats
+    ep0 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Prologue", order=1)
+    listed = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [(e["id"], e["episode_order"]) for e in listed] == [
+        (ep0["id"], 1),
+        (ep2_copy["id"], 2),
+        (ep3["id"], 3),
+        (ep3_copy["id"], 4),
+    ]
